# Model-search golden datasets

Each CSV is a deterministic synthetic dataset generated by
`eval/model_search.py`. The companion `manifest.json` records the target,
target kind, expected family (or families), leakage columns, and structural
notes for every file.

Regenerate the directory after changing a generator:

```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe eval\model_search.py --write-fixtures
```

`tests/test_model_search_eval.py` regenerates each frame in memory and checks
that it matches the committed CSV. All datasets are offline and use fixed
`numpy` seeds.
